metadata.name: SchemaCraft Pro - Programmatic JSON-LD Schema Generator & Local SEO Suite
metadata.target_audience: Digital Agencies, Local Business Owners, Freelance Web Designers
metadata.core_problem: Google search requires JSON-LD schema for rich snippets, but manual JSON creation is error-prone and existing tools charge $49+/mo.
metadata.solution: Standalone responsive web app + REST API + batch CSV exporter generating valid Schema.org markup (LocalBusiness, Organization, FAQ, HowTo, Product, Article, Event, JobPosting, Medical).

monetization.free_tier: Unlimited single schema generation & validation with live preview.
monetization.pro_tier: $19 one-time or $9/mo for CSV Bulk Import/Export, Whitelabel Embed Widget, and Multi-Location Local SEO Schema Pack.

metadata.hosting_stack: Static HTML5/Modern Vanilla JS (Zero runtime overhead, 100% free on Cloudflare Pages / GitHub Pages / Vercel) + optional Python micro-API.
